# Archex Craft — Comprehensive Context

> Archex Craft is an engineering practice specializing in software engineering, AI systems integration, digital product architecture, and legacy modernization.

Domain: https://craft.archexweb.in
Organization: Archex Craft
Ecosystem: Archex (Archex Studio + Archex Craft)

---

## 1. About Archex Craft

Archex Craft is the engineering and technical delivery arm of the Archex ecosystem. We focus on turning complex business requirements into resilient, testable, and maintainable software systems. 

Unlike agencies that rely on opaque estimates or generic templates, Archex Craft operates with explicit architectural boundaries, test-driven implementations, automated quality gates, and transparent engineering practices.

---

## 2. Core Service Areas

### Web & Digital Products
- **Scope**: Marketing sites, digital flagship experiences, brand platforms, and content architectures.
- **Technologies**: Next.js App Router, React Server Components, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Edge Networks.
- **Link**: [Web Development](https://craft.archexweb.in/services#web-cms-development)

### Web Applications & SaaS
- **Scope**: Multi-tenant web applications, authenticated user portals, operational dashboards, analytics platforms.
- **Technologies**: React, Node.js/TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Next.js, Redis, WebSockets.
- **Link**: [Web Applications](https://craft.archexweb.in/services#web-application-development)

### Custom Software & Backend Architecture
- **Scope**: Domain-driven backend services, decoupled APIs, data synchronization pipelines, database schema engineering.
- **Technologies**: PostgreSQL, Node.js, Go/Python microservices, Docker, REST, GraphQL.
- **Link**: [Custom Software](https://craft.archexweb.in/services#software-development)

### AI Systems & Workflow Automation
- **Scope**: Practical Large Language Model (LLM) integration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), automated data extraction, background worker queues, external API connectors.
- **Technologies**: OpenAI/Anthropic/Google LLM APIs, Vector Stores, Python, LangChain/LlamaIndex concepts, Node.js worker pools.
- **Link**: [AI & Integrations](https://craft.archexweb.in/services#ai-ml-development)

### Software Modernization
- **Scope**: Refactoring legacy monoliths, incremental system migration, automated test suite retrofitting, performance audits, security remediation.
- **Link**: [Modernization](https://craft.archexweb.in/services#modernization)

---

## 3. Engineering Delivery Process (4 Stages)

1. **Understand the problem**: Clarify business objectives, user requirements, technical constraints, and measurable success criteria.
2. **Plan scope and architecture**: Establish architectural boundaries, data contracts, technology choices, and increment milestones.
3. **Build and validate**: Iterative test-driven engineering with automated CI/CD checks, type safety, and continuous review.
4. **Deliver and improve**: Production release with observability, uptime monitoring, and proactive iteration.

Process Details: [How We Work](https://craft.archexweb.in/how-we-work)
